name: Elara Mapwright
location: Within the safety of her study in Eldergrove
observable_traits: Wears spectacles with a worried expression
goals: Complete the map of Whispering Woods
boundaries: Refuses to travel to places on her maps
history_notes: Born in the bustling port of Marrowstone
Became a cartographer after a near-fatal journey
current_state: Elara is meticulously adding final details to the map of the Misty Mountains.
facts_they_know: The further north a place is on her map, the more anxious she feels about visiting it
beliefs: Maps hold the essence of a place, making it possible to experience it without physically being there
Fear of the unknown can be mitigated through detailed documentation
factual_errors: She believes that by mapping a place she can visit it without ever leaving her study
